auth.intro: A good meal plan starts with you. Find recipes that fit your life and your budget.
auth.privacy: Your food preferences and budget are not saved in your account.
auth.registerDescription: Three details, and you are ready to go.
auth.loginDescription: Log in and plan your next shop.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
auth.sessionUnavailable: Your current session could not be verified.
auth.usernameInvalid: Choose a username with 3–30 permitted characters.
auth.birthDateHint: Your age helps us suggest suitable recipes.
auth.birthDateInvalid: Enter a valid date of birth that is not in the future.
auth.sessionFootnote: You stay logged in within this tab.
home.tagline: For your everyday life. And your budget.
home.description: What should I cook today? SmartSpoon finds recipes to suit your budget, your supermarket and your taste.
home.footnote: Your budget. Your preferences. Every time.
home.howTitle: From “What shall we eat?” to “Enjoy your meal.”
home.step1Text: Choose your supermarket, your budget and how many people you are cooking for.
home.step2Text: Vegetarian, vegan or a bit of everything? Tell us your allergies, preferences and available cooking time.
home.step3Text: Get suitable recipes and one shopping list with costs and leftover quantities.
home.testPrices: Prices currently come from a fictional test catalogue and are not current supermarket prices.
recipes.title: What is on the menu today?
recipes.description: A few details. Suitable recipes. Shopping that fits your budget.
recipes.shoppingDescription: Where do you shop, and who are you cooking for?
recipes.budgetHint: Up to €1,000 · applies to this recipe selection
recipes.budgetInvalid: Enter €0.01–€1,000 with no more than two decimal places.
recipes.peopleInvalid: Choose 1–10 people using a whole number.
recipes.foodDescription: Tell us what you would like to eat and how much time you have.
recipes.timeInvalid: Enter 5–180 minutes using a whole number.
recipes.allergyNotice: If you have allergies, check the manufacturer’s information and warnings about traces when shopping. Our test catalogue does not yet include this information.
recipes.reviewDescription: Check your details. We will then put together recipes for you.
recipes.planNotice: We create a recipe selection, not a complete weekly plan. Prices currently come from a fictional test catalogue.
recipes.generatingDescription: This may take about a minute. We also check the shopping costs.
recipes.packageNotice: We account for whole packs and share ingredients between recipes.
recipes.draftNotice: Your details are not saved in your profile. Reloading clears your draft and unsaved result.
results.title: Time for something good.
results.costNotice: Costs include whole packs for this recipe selection.
results.noWeeklyPlan: This selection is not a complete weekly plan.
results.savedPriceNotice: Saved prices are from the time the recipes were generated.
results.unsavedNotice: Without saving, details and results are lost when you reload.
save.title: Good ideas are worth keeping.
save.description: Save these recipes and the complete shopping list in your account. Your request details are not saved in your profile.
save.localChecks: Later changes to checkboxes stay local.
save.missingProof: This older selection has no saving proof. Create a new selection to save it.
save.name: Selection name
save.nameHint: 1–120 characters · save with the current checkboxes
shopping.title: Your shopping list
shopping.description: Quantities are combined for all selected recipes. Check off what you have already bought.
shopping.empty: There are no shopping items for this selection.
shopping.costNotice: Checkboxes do not change shopping costs or your remaining budget.
shopping.savedChecks: Your saved checkboxes have been restored; new changes only apply to this view.
shopping.unsavedChecks: Saving captures the current checkboxes. Later changes stay local.
shopping.testPrices: All prices are fictional test prices.
saved.title: Saved selections
saved.description: Your recipes and shopping lists. Just as you saved them.
saved.emptyTitle: A place for your favourite ideas.
saved.emptyDescription: Create recipes and save the selection with its shopping list. You will find it here later.
saved.snapshotNotice: Recipes, quantities and prices come from your saved selection. The checkboxes from when you saved were restored; new changes are not saved permanently.
nav.label: Main navigation
nav.earlyNotice: Early version · Prices are test data
